'''5T4''' was a small, [[Color/Legends|orange]]-colored, wheeled [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that served the company [[Tor-Ro-Bo Industries]]. 5T4 was based in [[Tor-Ro-Bo Processing Center 879]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]] and at some point, 5T4 greeted a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] that had been sent to the facility to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] some cargo for Tor-Ro-Bo, in breach of a [[Profit-Sharing Agreement Relaali 374.5.2|profit-sharing agreement]]. However, Tor-Ro-Bo's rival corporations learned of Tor-Ro-Bo's planned violation of the contract and they dispatched some security forces to attack the processing center. To cover up the spacers' presence in the facility, Tor-Ro-Bo activated the procedure [[protocol 514]], which caused the memories of 5T4 and the other droids in the facility to be [[Memory wipe/Legends|wiped]]. 5T4 subsequently forgot about the spacers and ceased to help them.<ref name="Imminent Impact" />
